original.target_description: Published 2020 article, Study 1: 145 MTurk participants, 2 × 2 between-subjects design; left-digit difference ($4.01 vs. $3.00 versus $4.00 vs. $2.99) × stimulus-based simultaneous versus memory-based sequential presentation, predicting seven-point evaluation of the Great Value peanut-butter price relative to the premium-brand price. Target: left-digit difference × evaluation-mode ANOVA interaction.

n.sample_role: Analytic participants for the Study 1 between-subjects interaction; all 145 MTurk panelists retained, one target price evaluation per participant.
n.exclusions: No observations excluded in Study 1; the explicit exception in the overview applies only to Study 4.
n.location: Published p. 774 (PDF p. 4), Overview of Studies and Study 1 Method, Participants and procedure.
n.quote: One hundred forty-five Amazon … Mechanical Turk (MTurk) panelists (Mage ¼ 37.8 years; 54% … female) took part in this study.

es.location: Published p. 777 (PDF p. 7), Table 2, Study 1, Left-digit difference × Evaluation mode row, Effect Size column; interaction also p. 776 (PDF p. 6), Results.
es.quote: Effect                                                                                           df1/df2         F            Effect Size ( Z 2p ) ... Left-digit difference  Evaluation mode                                                           1/141         4.84                 .033

p.location: Published p. 776 (PDF p. 6), Study 1 Results, first sentence, interaction between left-digit difference and evaluation mode.
p.quote: A two-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) revealed a signifi- ... cant interaction between left-digit difference and evaluation ... mode (F(1, 141) ¼ 4.84, p ¼ .029).

replication.target_description: Replication 1: MTurk participants; peanut-butter store-brand relative-price rating; interaction of same-screen versus sequential presentation and $4.00/$2.99 versus $4.01/$3.00 prices.

n.sample_role: Participants retained after exclusions for the target replication analysis
n.exclusions: Preregistered exclusion of duplicate MTurk IDs or IP addresses, and actual MTurk IDs differing from reported IDs. Replication 2 used CloudResearch Approved Participants; both used >=98% approval and >=1,000 HITs. Post-task attention-check failure was not an exclusion in these primary results.
n.location: The Replications, paragraph beginning In the pre-registered replications; exclusions in footnote 4
n.quote: After exclusions, we wound up with 1,099 participants in Replication 1 (~7.5 times the original sample size) and 1,555 participants in Replication 2 (~10.7 times the original sample size)

es.metric: b (regression interaction coefficient; standardization not specified)
es.location: Results, Original vs. Replication Results: Store Brand Price Evaluation figure, Replication 1 panel, Interaction label

p.location: Results, Original vs. Replication Results: Store Brand Price Evaluation figure, Replication 1 panel, Interaction label

reported_success.quote: we find marginally significant support for the authors’ key interaction in both replications.

notes:
Original acquisition failed at publisher and repository full-text routes; see original DOI cache miss. The replication report reproduces original-study statistics, but these were not substituted for original-paper extraction. Replication figure prints b rather than explicitly standardized beta; no conversion performed. Success coded mixed from the replication authors’ marginal-support narrative and their conclusion that the effect is much smaller than originally reported. The stimulus presentation includes intervening asterisk screens as documented in footnote 6.
Source follow-up: Fresh original-only extraction from the named published article, not a manuscript/proof or supplement. Title, authors and DOI match the supplied reference. Rendered PDF pages 4, 6 and 7 (published pp. 774, 776–777) were inspected to verify sample, design, interaction, effect-size column and p-value. The locator p.4&6 uses PDF pagination. The printed target outcome is the store-brand price-magnitude rating relative to the premium-brand price, operationalizing the described perceived price difference. Requested standardized beta is not printed for this ANOVA: retained printed partial eta-squared .033 for the same interaction as p = .029; no conversion. The frozen canonical text uses ¼ for the rendered equals sign, control glyph U+0004 for the rendered multiplication sign, and Z in the rendered eta-squared column header; quotations retain these exact glyphs and table spacing. Explicit ellipses mark omitted interleaved column text and intervening material; canonical line-end hyphenation is retained. Both assigned audit IDs identify this same original Study 1 interaction and were matched to that primary test. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders, not acquisition failures.
